messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

Each morning, the files which have yet to be processed need to be checked, to make sure they are in order for the court hearing that day. If some files are missing, a search is initiated, otherwise the files can be physically tracked to the intended location. Once all the files are ready, these are handed to the Associate, and meantime the Judgeis Lawlist is distributed to the relevant people. Afterwards, the directions hearings are conducted.

<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

             id="Definitions_1"
             targetNamespace="http://bpmn.org/schema/bpmn">

  <process id="Court_Preparation_Process" isExecutable="true">
    
    <!-- Start Event: Morning Process Triggered -->
    <startEvent id="StartEvent_Morning" name="Morning Process Started">
      <outgoing">Flow_1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <!-- Task: Check Unprocessed Files -->
    <userTask id="Task_CheckFiles" name="Check Unprocessed Files">
      <incoming>Flow_1</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_2</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway: Are Files Missing? -->
    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckMissing" name="Files Missing?">
      <incoming>Flow_2</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_Missing</outgoing>
      <outgoing">Flow_NotMissing</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Task: Search for Missing Files -->
    <userTask id="Task_SearchFiles" name="Initiate Search for Missing Files">
      <incoming>Flow_Missing</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_SearchDone</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Task: Physically Track Files -->
    <userTask id="Task_TrackFiles" name="Physically Track Files to Intended Location">
      <incoming>Flow_NotMissing</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_TrackDone</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway: Merge Files Readiness -->
    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FilesReady" name="Files Ready Gateway">
      <incoming>Flow_SearchDone</incoming>
      <incoming>Flow_TrackDone</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_ToParallelSplit</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Parallel Gateway: Fork Parallel Preparation Tasks -->
    <parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Parallel Split">
      <incoming>Flow_ToParallelSplit</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_ToHandover</outgoing>
      <outgoing">Flow_ToDistribute</outgoing>
    </parallelGateway>

    <!-- Task: Hand Files to Associate -->
    <userTask id="Task_HandoverFiles" name="Hand Over Files to Associate">
      <incoming>Flow_ToHandover</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_HandoverDone</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Task: Distribute Judge's Law List -->
    <userTask id="Task_DistributeLawlist" name="Distribute Judge's Law List to Relevant People">
      <incoming>Flow_ToDistribute</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_DistributeDone</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Parallel Gateway: Join Parallel Preparation Tasks -->
    <parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Parallel Join">
      <incoming>Flow_HandoverDone</incoming>
      <incoming>Flow_DistributeDone</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_ToConductHearings</outgoing>
    </parallelGateway>

    <!-- Task: Conduct Directions Hearings -->
    <userTask id="Task_ConductHearings" name="Conduct Directions Hearings">
      <incoming>Flow_ToConductHearings</incoming>
      <outgoing">Flow_End</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- End Event -->
    <endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Preparation and Hearings Completed">
      <incoming>Flow_End</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Morning" targetRef="Task_CheckFiles"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckFiles" targetRef="Gateway_CheckMissing"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_Missing" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckMissing" targetRef="Task_SearchFiles"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotMissing" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckMissing" targetRef="Task_TrackFiles"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_SearchDone" sourceRef="Task_SearchFiles" targetRef="Gateway_FilesReady"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackDone" sourceRef="Task_TrackFiles" targetRef="Gateway_FilesReady"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToParallelSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_FilesReady" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToHandover" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_HandoverFiles"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDistribute" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_DistributeLawlist"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandoverDone" sourceRef="Task_HandoverFiles" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistributeDone" sourceRef="Task_DistributeLawlist" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToConductHearings" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_ConductHearings"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Task_ConductHearings" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
